notes.hook: A nuclear drone flying across an alien moon is an irresistible premise paired with strong title text.
notes.clarity: The comparison between slow Mars rovers and Titan's dense air makes the physics immediately intuitive.
notes.payoff: The reveal that a single flight covers more ground than Curiosity did in an entire decade delivers a killer payoff.
notes.visuals: Every render, diagram, and title card is sharp, informative, and visually engaging on mobile screens.
notes.loop: Ending on 'it'll fly' flows effortlessly into 'A nuclear drone will fly across a frozen moon' visually and verbally.

rounds.better_than_last: It sets up the slow pace of wheeled rovers early and pays it off powerfully by quantifying how a single Dragonfly hop outperforms a decade of rover driving.
